title.narrative: Activity under preparation EU for Fight against Corruption - AL2024AAP

description.narrative: The overall objective of the action is to help reduce corruption in Albania through prevention, repression and awareness raising. The ultimate objective is to promote transparent and high-integrity Albanian institutions that enjoy citizens' trust and ensure a quality and incorruptible service.The Action supports Albanian institutions in aligning and implementing EU recommendations and best practices in the anti-corruption field which became increasingly an integrated horizontal approach to several areas of interventions after opening of the accession negotiations in 2022. The first Intergovernmental Conference (IGC) on accession negotiations was held between the EU and Albania, July19, 2022. This marked the formal start of the accession talks. Additionally, the European Commission started the screening process and the Albanian authorities are in the process of preparing the Roadmap on Rule of Law, which will serve as an opening benchmark. The roadmap contains specific provisions addressing the findings of the Screening Report on addressing corruption, which encompass a period from 2024 to 2030. The specific objectives of this action is to assist the relevant Albanian authorities, including the General Directorate of Anti-Corruption, HIDAACI and SPAK regarding their respective prevention and repressive role in the context of the fight against corruption and trust of citizens in public bodies, while focusing on high risk sectors prone to corruption. The expected outcome is to advance in the roll-out of anti-corruption policies and to improve institutional practice in the fight against corruption.
